dialog.english:
Chosen Children... thank you for
coming.
What's wrong, Centarumon?

There's something I've been
worried about.
What's happenin'?

Every night, at the ruins, I hear
a suspicious voice.
dialog.translation:
Cada noche, en las ruinas, oigo
una voz sospechosa.

dialog.english:
There's no evidence the ruins have
been vandalized, but as its
guardian, I can't overlook this.
dialog.translation:
No hay rastro de destrozos,
pero como su guardián, no
puedo pasarlo por alto.

dialog.english: Could it be... a ghost...?
It can't be. Ghosts don't exist.

So then what about the Digimon? Or
this world?

I'm sure there must be a
scientific explanation for
those...
dialog.translation:
Seguro que todo eso tiene
una explicación científica...

dialog.english: But ghosts aren't very scientific.
dialog.translation:
Pero los fantasmas no son muy
científicos.

dialog.english:
You're surprisingly stubborn,
Izzy...
So, why don't we look into it?

It sounds interesting. We'll prove
that ghosts don't exist!
dialog.translation:
Suena interesante. ¡Vamos a
demostrar que no existen!

dialog.english: Please, and thank you very much.

If I weren't wounded when I was
being controlled by the black
gear, I would help, but...
dialog.translation:
Si no me hubieran herido
cuando me controlaba la
rueda negra, os ayudaría.

dialog.english:
We'll be fine by ourselves. Let's
go, everyone!

Sleeeeeeep... sleeeeeeeep... in
the darkness...
Noooooooo! It really *is* a ghost!
Stop, Mimi! Don't push me!
Who's there? Come out!
The voice is gone!
There's nobody here.

Perhaps it's just natural wind
passing through a hole, making a
disturbing sound.
dialog.translation:
Será el viento al pasar por
un agujero, que hace un
ruido inquietante.

dialog.english: Good eeeeeeeeeveniiiiiiiiing!
Aaaack!

I'm sorry! Did my sutra disturb
you?

Sutra?! You mean that "sleeeeeeep"
thing?

Yeah! I used to live with another
Bakemon in a church...
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! Vivía con otro Bakemon
en una iglesia...

dialog.english:
But he ascended recently, so I'm
using my own original sutra.
dialog.translation:
Pero hace poco ascendió, así
que recito mi propio sutra.

dialog.english: Joe... could this be...

...a friend of the Bakemon we
defeated?!

So it was a Digimon after all...
I'm disappointed, it wasn't a
ghost...
dialog.translation:
Al final era un Digimon...
Qué chasco, no era un
fantasma...

dialog.english:
We should go back soon, or else
Centarumon will be worried.
dialog.translation:
Deberíamos volver, o
Centarumon se preocupará.

dialog.english:
...so in any case, it was a
Bakemon who was loitering there.
dialog.translation:
...total, que era un Bakemon
que rondaba por allí.

dialog.english:
Pretty harmless guy, just had a
real loud voice.
dialog.translation:
Un tipo inofensivo, solo
que con un vozarrón.

dialog.english:
It wasn't a looter? I'm relieved.
Thank you, everyone.
dialog.translation:
¿No era un saqueador? Qué
alivio. Gracias, chicos.

dialog.english:
As thanks for your help, I'll give
you this.
dialog.translation:
Por vuestra ayuda, os doy
esto.

dialog.english: Thank you!

But I wanted to see a *real*
ghost... This is so
disappointing...
dialog.translation:
Pero yo quería ver un
fantasma DE VERDAD...
Qué decepción...

dialog.english:
Really? For me, the result was
rather fascinating.
dialog.translation:
¿Sí? A mí el resultado me
pareció fascinante.

dialog.english:
Why? You weren't expecting ghosts
anyway.
dialog.translation:
¿Por qué? Si tú no esperabas
fantasmas.

dialog.english:
It's just that... we saw a Digimon
using a sutra for his friend, so
that he'd ascend.
dialog.translation:
Es que... vimos a un Digimon
recitar un sutra para que su
amigo ascendiera.

dialog.english:
We learned more about Digimon...
so it was an interesting journey.
dialog.translation:
Aprendimos más sobre los
Digimon... fue un viaje
interesante.

dialog.english:
You're so interested in such
complicated things.
dialog.translation:
Te interesan las cosas
muy complicadas.

dialog.english:
But that's what I like 'bout
Izzy, y'know.
dialog.translation:
Pero eso es lo que me
gusta de Izzy, ¿sabes?
